findings.title: Heat-pump switch slot accepts input_boolean/climate but _apply_action only ever calls switch.turn_on/off
findings.claim: An input_boolean or climate entity mapped to heat_pump_switch_entity via the integration's own assign_entity service is sent switch.turn_on/turn_off every cycle, a call Home Assistant's entity-service routing resolves to no entity, so the pump is never actuated while a plan publishes normally.
findings.mechanism: topology._SLOTS gives heat_pump_switch_entity the domains (switch, input_boolean, climate); services.handle_assign_entity validates against that and stores it; coordinator._apply_action hard-codes async_call('switch', ...). Sibling writers (_async_set_pump, DisinfectionSwitch._write) use 'homeassistant', _command_valve_target branches on domain.

findings.title: Hot water boost switch overlays 4 kW DHW onto the live action on installs with no DHW tank
findings.claim: On every no-DHW cell tested, turning on the always-created BoostDhwSwitch makes the next cycle's action carry dhw_power=0.8*max_power (4.0 kW), publish dhw_heating_active=True and force heat_pump_on, adding 4.0 kW to _commanded_power.
findings.mechanism: switch.async_setup_entry creates BoostDhwSwitch unconditionally; boost.apply/overlay writes the DHW channel without reading params.dhw_enabled; _commanded_power feeds accuracy predictions, peak guard and frequency recommendation.
